explanation: Body moving fast horizontally (-13.15 m/s) grazes the vertical face / corner region of wall (x=1.7,w=7.5 top edge y~8.8?). Substep collision correction fails to keep penetration under 0.15 tolerance; penetration grows from ~0.03 at step 18 to 0.18 at step 19. Reducing horizontal speed eliminates penetration, confirming high tangential velocity causes missed/ insufficient positional correction at wall edge.
